findings.title: Claude subagent is granted the Bash tool
findings.explanation: This AgentDefinition grants the built-in Bash tool, giving the subagent arbitrary shell-command execution. Subagents are dispatched autonomously by a lead agent in response to model-generated task descriptions, so a prompt-injected or mis-scoped task can reach the shell with no human in the loop. This is acute when the surrounding ClaudeAgentOptions sets permission_mode="bypassPermissions", which removes the SDK's interactive approval gate entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove "Bash" from this subagent's tools list unless shell execution is essential to its job. If it is essential, gate it with a PreToolUse hook that allowlists the specific commands the subagent may run, and do not pair it with permission_mode="bypassPermissions" at the ClaudeAgentOptions level.
findings.ai_explanation: The data-analyst subagent lists Bash, so any delegated task can run shell commands.
findings.ai_fix: Removed Bash from the data-analyst tools list.
